component.name: Deus Ex
component.summary: Open-source reimplementation of the Deus Ex engine

description.p: An open-source reimplementation of the Deus Ex engine and of UnrealEd. It runs the original game's UnrealScript bytecode from the shipped packages on a new C++ engine built on SDL2 and OpenGL 3.3. The original game data is required and is not included.
